references.text: The first time the feast of 'Tabernacles' (Sukkot) is commanded in the Torah, which is the same feast referred to in John 7:2.
A detailed description of the dates and duration of the Feast of Tabernacles, providing context that the feast was 'near' in John 7:2.
Repeated command to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles, confirming that this was a fixed, well-known festival in the Jewish calendar.
Description of King Solomon celebrating the Feast of Tabernacles in Jerusalem, establishing historical and religious context for the feast in the New Testament.
Description of the rebuilding of the booths under Ezra's leadership, showing that the feast continued to be celebrated strictly according to the law.
